incident-bot: PAGING — SLO alert: elevated 5xx on /v1/prompt (edge route). 18% errors over 5m, triggered oncall. https://pd.example/INC12345
Sophie M: acked. I'm oncall. Pulling dashboards now -> looks like new-edge-proxy canary (10%) is getting the majority of failing traffic.
Sophie M: stack traces show repeated 'tokenizer: malformed frame' + proxy retries, lots of 503s from the edge pool.
Mike T: grabbing runtime logs. I see quantized-model kernel mismatch errors on a subset of GPUs, fallback loop triggers and fills proxy queue -> head-of-line blocking.
Jordan L: if that's true we should flip routing to the stable pathway. We have feature flag edge_route_v2 that routes to new-edge-proxy for canary. Kill it to force stable route.
Sophie M: agreed. Runbook recommends FF kill for rapid evacuation. CS impact looks medium (some API clients 502/503).
Jordan L: executing ffctl now:
```
ffctl toggle edge_route_v2 off --env prod --actor jordan --reason "emergency 5xx canary"
```
deploy-bot: feature-flag-service: edge_route_v2 -> OFF (actor: Jordan L). Propagation to edge routers in progress.
Sophie M: monitoring metrics. Elaine, can you watch latency and 5xx across customer segments?
Elaine R: pulling per-tenant charts. Within 90s error rate dropped from 18% -> 3% for routed customers. Tail latency also trending down.
Sophie M: nice. Can CS Ops draft an alert/campaign for customers who hit 5xx in last 30m? We should be transparent.
CS Ops: on it. Draft: "We detected intermittent errors for some prompt requests due to a canary routing issue. We have routed traffic to the stable path and errors are resolving. If you continue to see failures, reply here or open a support ticket."
Mike T: while we stabilized, I've captured a sample of failing traces and kernel logs -> uploading to /internal/incident/INC12345/artifacts. Looks like a model quantization mismatch combined with an edge tokenizer upgrade.
Jordan L: next steps: revert canary build in registry, run compatibility tests, and add a stricter preflight for kernel-model compatibility. I'll open a PR for the revert and a test job.
Sophie M: I'm going to mark this mitigated and stay on till end-of-rotation. Oncall handoff at 1766124340 — next oncall please monitor for 30m.
Elaine R: confirming 5xx under 1% for 10m, no new spikes.
deploy-bot: pager resolve recorded by Sophie M for INC12345.
Sophie M: creating a short postmortem ticket (ENG-INC-2026-03-edge-route) with timeline, root cause hypothesis, and action items: 1) rollback canary build, 2) tighten ff gating + preflight, 3) CS customer outreach.
Jordan L: note for postmortem — consider automatic circuit-breaker at proxy level if retry loop > X to avoid cascading.
Sophie M: thanks all. CS Ops will send the customer message once I paste the verified mitigated wording. I'll update the incident channel when we close. :white_check_mark:
